execution_policy.baseline_artifact: Save existing KEEP train80/dev32/retain28 actual F32 scores plus labels/query IDs/gallery IDs/groups to SHA-sealed BASELINE_SCORES.npz; zero additional model calls.
execution_policy.cold_cost: Imports, model initialization, prototypes, solve, compile, optimizer, evaluation and serialization measured; dependency setup/download reported separately; no speed claim without matched quality.
execution_policy.full_rollout_accounting: Every original or reimplemented complete wrapper forward must pass the ledger. The code uses only the original public Hybrid forward; no hidden uncounted rollout.
execution_policy.method_cost_accounting: Per method: observed whole two-candidate fit/compile cost plus both candidate two-call evaluation costs, with shared cold initialization/qualification/KEEP trace cost shown separately and once in actual global cost. Shared allocation is not an independent cold-run measurement or a speed claim.
execution_policy.nested_original_autograd: 17 counts outer loss.backward calls. The pinned original QVI custom backward internally calls torch.autograd.grad for its analytic implicit derivative; these nested operations are included in CPU cost, not an unreported training run.
execution_policy.physical_failure_during_candidate_or_tra: ABORT entire pilot, preserve partial budget and any completed candidates; no substitution
execution_policy.qualification_failure: ABORT entire pilot, preserve partial budget
execution_policy.resource_guard: Dedicated systemd service MemoryMax1GiB CPUQuota100% TasksMax64 RuntimeMaxSec330. Supervisor checks cgroup limits, pins one available CPU, stops at 180 aggregate cgroup CPU seconds or 300 active wall seconds with 0.2s observation granularity plus OS scheduling; child RLIMIT_CPU180/181 is an outer backup. Per-return20s gate is not atomic preemption.
execution_policy.tensor_scope: CPU Torch serialization preserves exact non-scope registered tensor/buffer value bytes and aliases, not original ZIP/header bytes; actual saved complete checkpoint is reloaded before each candidate model evaluation.
